say:1:1131023001:1.text: *Sniff*... hmm... you do smell different than those scoundrels.
say:1:1131023001:1.source_cn: 嗅嗅……好吧，你的气味确实和那些混蛋不一样。
say:1:1131023001:1.male: *Sniff*... hmm... you do smell different than those scoundrels.
say:1:1131023001:1.female: *Sniff*... hmm... you do smell different than those scoundrels.

say:2:1131023002:1.text: All the young and able of our clan were either tricked by the Adamant Syndicate into looking for treasure or taken by Quicksand Claws!
say:2:1131023002:1.source_cn: 我们部族里的青壮年，要么是被黑金骗去找宝藏了，要么就是...
say:2:1131023002:1.male: All the young and able of our clan were either tricked by the Adamant Syndicate into looking for treasure or taken by Quicksand Claws!
say:2:1131023002:1.female: All the young and able of our clan were either tricked by the Adamant Syndicate into looking for treasure or taken by Quicksand Claws!

say:3:1131023003:1.text: Doing hard labor wasn't the issue—they had zero concern for our safety!
say:3:1131023003:1.source_cn: 要只是当苦力也就算了，可他们完全不顾我们的安危！
say:3:1131023003:1.male: Doing hard labor wasn't the issue—they had zero concern for our safety!
say:3:1131023003:1.female: Doing hard labor wasn't the issue—they had zero concern for our safety!

say:4:1131023004:1.text: They're responsible for all the lives lost in that tunnel, and there's nothing they can do to fix it!
say:4:1131023004:1.source_cn: 隧道里有那么多人遇难，这都是他们的过错！这种伤害永远也...
say:4:1131023004:1.male: They're responsible for all the lives lost in that tunnel, and there's nothing they can do to fix it!
say:4:1131023004:1.female: They're responsible for all the lives lost in that tunnel, and there's nothing they can do to fix it!

say:5:1131023005:1.text: If the Adamant Syndicate and Quicksand Claws ever dare to return, I'll tear them all apart!
say:5:1131023005:1.source_cn: 要是黑金和流沙之爪再敢出现，就等着我收拾他们吧！
say:5:1131023005:1.male: If the Adamant Syndicate and Quicksand Claws ever dare to return, I'll tear them all apart!
say:5:1131023005:1.female: If the Adamant Syndicate and Quicksand Claws ever dare to return, I'll tear them all apart!
